agent.consignments.sendNowNote: Not full yet: send the {kg} kg pooled so far as a load now — a truck is free, or the market is today. It is posted to drivers as a full lot is.
agent.rateDriver.title: Rate the driver
agent.rateDriver.howNamed: How did {name} do on this run?
agent.rateDriver.howAnon: How did the driver do on this run?
agent.records.emptyParcels: No parcels yet. Take one in and it lands here.
agent.records.summaryHint: Your money in, out and net — for whatever you filter to below.
agent.records.emptyEntries: No entries yet. Take in a parcel or top up and it lands here.
agent.records.aloudView: In this view: {in} in, {out} out, net {net}.
agent.shelf.title: Your pickup shelves
agent.shelf.lede: Set how many shelves you have. Parcels for collection are placed on them by colour and number.
agent.shelf.freeOf: {free} of {total, plural, one {# slot} other {# slots}} free
agent.shelf.bundleHint: Tap an empty slot to make it a bundle slot — letters and small parcels share it instead of each taking a whole slot.
agent.shelf.minSlots: A shelf needs at least {min, plural, one {# slot} other {# slots}}.
agent.shelf.orphanOne: {count} parcel is on a slot you would remove. Hand it out or move it first.
agent.shelf.orphanMany: {count} parcels are on slots you would remove. Hand them out or move them first.
agent.shelf.baysLabel: Bags you work on at once
agent.shelf.cornerLabel: Closed bags you can keep in a corner
agent.shelf.baysNote: An open bag needs room beside the counter while you fill it. A closed bag waiting for a driver can stand in any free corner: say how many you can keep there if a driver is late. A closed bag with no corner left stands where you work, and you cannot open another in its place.
agent.shelf.aloud: You have {total} shelf slots, {free} free. Change the number of rows and colour columns, then save.
agent.loc.title: Where your shop is
agent.loc.mapLabel: Your shop on the map — drag the pin to move it
agent.loc.wordsLabel: Find your spot by three words
agent.loc.noPin: Tap the map to drop your pin.
agent.hours.title: Opening hours
agent.hours.hint: Set when your shop is open each day. A closed day takes no drop-offs.
agent.toast.geoNotFound: Could not find that place — try a nearby area, or use the map.
agent.toast.geoMarked: Marked on the map — the nearest shops are first.
agent.toast.topUpAskedDetail: Reference {reference}. Your wallet changes when the payment is confirmed.
agent.toast.shopOpenDetail: You will get parcels again. The buyers of parcels on your shelf are told, and the time you were closed is added back to their days to collect.
agent.toast.shopClosedDetail: The buyers of parcels on their way here are asked to choose a shop near you instead. The buyers of parcels on your shelf are told, and their days to collect stop counting until you open.
agent.toast.baysSavedDetail: {count, plural, one {# bag} other {# bags}} open at once, and {closed, plural, =0 {no closed bags in a corner} one {# closed bag in a corner} other {# closed bags in a corner}}.
agent.toast.shelfSavedDetail: Now {total, plural, one {# slot} other {# slots}}.
agent.toast.parcelAcceptedDetail: A tracking message has been sent.
agent.toast.freightBookedCode: Collect the cash, hand the customer code {code}.
agent.toast.freightBookedFallback: A driver will be found for this load.
agent.toast.driverRatedDetail: Thank you — this helps the whole network.
agent.toast.lotOpenedDetail: Add member deposits until it fills.
agent.toast.lotSentDetail: {code} is posted to drivers, with its consignment note.
agent.toast.lotFullDetail: A truck will be found for lot {code}.
agent.toast.takenInCash: Collect {amount} in cash from the sender.
agent.toast.takenInPrepaid: Prepaid by the store — nothing to collect.
agent.toast.onBusTitle: {count, plural, one {# parcel} other {# parcels}} on the bus
agent.toast.onBusLeft: {count} left behind — the control tower has been told.
agent.toast.onBusCapped: {count} stay here: the rider carries the most a new rider may for now. Hand them to the next one.
agent.toast.arrivedDetail: It is on the shelf, waiting for its code.
agent.toast.arrivedAt: Put it on shelf {slot}. It waits there for its code.
agent.toast.bagPutAway: Each parcel has a slot. Put them in now.
agent.toast.disputeFiledDetail: It waits for a decision. The parcel stays on your shelf until then.
agent.toast.problemRecordedDetail: A damage claim report was made, and the customer has it in their app. The parcel can still be handed over.
agent.toast.bagReceivedDetail: {count, plural, one {# parcel} other {# parcels}} shelved for pickup.
agent.toast.notShopDetail: This sign-in belongs to a {role} account — open the {role} app instead.
agent.toast.photoHeld: No signal: the photo waits on this phone
agent.toast.photoHeldDetail: It goes with the take-in when there is a signal.
agent.toast.parcelQueued: Taken in: it goes when there is a signal
agent.toast.parcelQueuedDetail: The label and the release code come when it reaches SeeBuyGet.
agent.accept.queuedTitle: Taken in, waiting for a signal
agent.accept.queuedBody: {parcel} is taken in on this phone and goes to SeeBuyGet when there is a signal. Its label and release code are made then, and shown here once: give the code to the sender, or phone them on the number they gave.
agent.toast.lateTakeInDetail: Its label and release code are ready. They show once.
agent.accept.lateTitle: Taken in earlier: label and code ready
agent.accept.lateBody: {parcel} was taken in without a signal at {time}. Print its label and stick it on. Give the release code to the sender: it is shown only this once.
agent.accept.lateCall: If the sender has gone, phone them on {phone}.
agent.accept.lateNext: Done. {n, plural, one {# more is} other {# more are}} ready
agent.home.topUpNeedsSignalDetail: The money is asked of M-Pesa through SeeBuyGet, so it waits for a signal. Nothing is taken from anybody until then.
agent.signin.deviceLede: This phone has not signed in to the shop before. A code went to the shop’s number ending {sentTo}.
agent.signin.deviceCode: The 6-digit code from the text message
agent.signin.deviceWhy: The shop’s sign-in works only on the shop’s own phones, so a password that is passed round does not open the counter anywhere else.
agent.counter.noSignalDetail: The pickup code is checked by SeeBuyGet, so a parcel is handed over only when there is a signal. Taking parcels in, giving them to a driver and shelving still work: they wait on this phone.
agent.door.title: For a business’s own door
agent.door.lede: A business had these sent here on their way to its own place. Keep each on the shelf, and hand it only to the driver who took its load: scan their pass.
agent.door.waiting: No driver has taken load {code} yet.
agent.door.taken: A driver has taken load {code}: hand it over when they show their pass.
agent.door.takenBy: {name} took load {code}: hand it over when they show their pass.
agent.door.handed: {parcel} is with the driver of load {code}, on its way to its door.
agent.freightSteps.openReady: Measured, and its shop chosen. Book it as freight: the cash budget, the load, who to call, and the driver’s instructions, one at a time.
agent.freightSteps.bar: Booking freight · goes out at the last step
agent.freightSteps.t.price: The cash budget, and when it goes
agent.freightSteps.t.load: How is it packed, and what truck?
agent.freightSteps.stepReady: This part is done. Tap Next.
agent.freightSteps.checkLede: Nothing is booked yet, and no driver sees it. Change any part; it goes out only when you tap Book the freight.
agent.freightSteps.nothingGiven: Nothing given — all of it can be left empty.
agent.freightSteps.v.instant: The first suitable truck takes it at our rate
agent.freightSteps.seeNowInstant: Once booked it is on the marketplace at once: a nearby truck that can carry it is offered it, and no driver can be paid more than the cash budget.
agent.freightSteps.seeNowNegotiate: Once booked it is on the drivers’ board at once: drivers send you their price, and nobody takes it until you pick one — never above the cash budget.
agent.freightSteps.seePlanned: Once booked it waits until {when}, then goes to drivers.
agent.freightSteps.seeEarly: A driver can reserve it before the day.
agent.freightSteps.seeNotEarly: No driver sees it before the day.
agent.collect.checkNameDetail: This code was emailed, and an email can be forwarded. Hand the parcel over only to the person named.
agent.accept.receiverEmailHint: Their delivery code is emailed to them once a driver has the load, and the driver checks the name above.
agent.freight.codeLine: Delivery code: {code}. The receiver gives it to the driver.
agent.freight.arrivedSaid: Said arrived: the driver may deliver without the code.
agent.accept.paidOnlineDetail: Nothing to take: the sender paid when booking, and the label is on the parcel or on their phone. Photograph it and take it in.
